no_trade_day_explanation: No paper order was submitted during the trading day; EOD analysis still scans broad-market movers and reconstructs candidate setups.

optimization_policy.required_next_step: Validate generalized proposals on multiple days and out-of-sample data before activation.

limitations: An EOD move alone is not proof that an executable trade existed at the decision price.
A reconstructed setup is a historical heuristic and is not a trade authorization.
The broad-market scan currently reconstructs only the configured top movers, not every NSE symbol.
The report never automatically changes strategy code.
